mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate over the prior month compresses the equity risk premium by raising discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of rising FEDFUNDS are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, the resulting monetary tightening cycle compresses equity risk premiums, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) signals accelerating labor market deterioration, triggering negative equity returns due to recessionary expectations over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of PAYEMS decline and UNRATE rise does not produce negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 320), a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where CPIAUCSL > 320, HOUST decline does not lead to negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate over the prior month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, compressing consumer spending and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of rising UNRATE are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.5%, labor market slack triggers negative equity returns due to reduced consumer spending over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production over the prior month signals weakening economic output, reducing corporate earnings expectations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in periods of declining INDPRO are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) over the prior 2 months signals strengthening consumer demand, supporting corporate earnings and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in periods of rising RSAFS are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
